headline: Extreme heat through Sunday — zone 2 overdue, harvest berries.
weather_notes: Run zone 2 today — 4 days without irrigation under the Extreme Heat Warning; zone 1 ran this morning but zone 2 beds remain dry.
Do all outdoor work before 8 AM through Sunday — Extreme Heat Warning active through Aug 10 with 100°F today, 103°F Friday, and 102°F Saturday.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM through the weekend — 100–103°F puts 47-day transplants at sunscald risk with first harvest still 18+ days out.
Move or shade potato bags from direct afternoon sun — grow bag root zones reach lethal temperatures under sustained 100°F+ heat.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 27 days overdue — today and tomorrow morning before 8 AM are the last outdoor windows before 103°F Friday closes cane work through the weekend.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest ripe blackberries before Friday
suggested_tasks.description: Berries confirmed June 14 are 53 days in — 103°F Friday will bake any remaining ripe Triple Crown fruit still on the canes.

suggested_tasks.title: Probe potato bags — end of harvest window
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 79 days hits the end of the 65–80 day harvest window — probe one bag today before heat-accelerated vine dieback closes the opportunity.
